title: Consent rows may name any-adopter
summary: A consent row side may name any-adopter: the words of every system that requires the ledger's system. work-system admits adopter words on its require and ground rows and admits a spec requiring a contract or another spec, so an adopting workspace's own words can depend on core work records and the coverage chain from spec to contract is consented. any-adopter cannot be registered as a word. Records authored outside a system folder were already admitted; that behaviour is now locked by a test.
